project_info.theme: Educational infographic explaining broad-spectrum ZnO absorption

main_subject.detail: A pastel infographic dominated by giant white letters 'ZnO' above a horizontal color-spectrum bar labeled UVB, UVA, HEV, ÁNH SÁNG KHẢ KIẾN (VIS), and TIA HỒNG NGOẠI (IR), with an absorption graph and caption about broad-spectrum absorption of inorganic ZnO filters.
main_subject.style: Modern scientific beauty infographic, pastel educational graphic, clean minimal data visualization

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'ZnO', spectrum labels 'UVB', 'UVA', 'HEV', 'ÁNH SÁNG KHẢ KIẾN (VIS)', 'TIA HỒNG NGOẠI (IR)', side label 'ĐỘ HẤP THU', right text 'SAU KHI TIẾP XÚC UV', main caption 'Biểu đồ thể hiện độ hấp thụ quang phổ rộng của màng lọc vô cơ ZnO(*)', and footnote '(* )Kiểm nghiệm invitro đo lường chỉ số bảo vệ quang phổ rộng tại trung tâm Weneos (Pháp).'.
items: Top Left: Huge oversized white letters 'ZnO' cropped by the frame on a pink pastel backdrop.
Top Right: Rounded blue gradient blob overlapping the upper-right edge.
Bottom Left: White absorption-area graph shape under the spectrum bar with dashed vertical guides and the vertical label 'ĐỘ HẤP THU'.
Bottom Right: Black text 'SAU KHI TIẾP XÚC UV' and the caption-plus-footnote area.
Center/Background: Horizontal rainbow spectrum bar running across the graphic with wavelength markers 290, 320, 400, 500, 800, 1400.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean vector-like clarity, soft pastel gradients, polished infographic readability
